newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended May 21 rose to $961.93 billion from a revised $959.28 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 663 retail money market mutual funds rose $4.33 billion to $641.56 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds rose $3.42 billion to $528.20 billion, while assets of the 260 tax-exempt funds rose $910.8 million to $113.36 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 322 institutional money market funds fell $1.68 billion to $320.37 billion. Of these, assets of the 260 taxable money market funds decreased $2.10 billion to $286.33 billion, while assets of the 62 tax-exempt funds rose $419.7 million to $34.04 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $959.28 billion from $959.43 billion.
